one_liner: Facts choose the owner: Temporal clocks, launchd serves, LangGraph cycles, Orca reasons, Kestra schedules, plain Python computes. Controls are code, effects wait at Gate-D. There is no default owner.

supersedes.note: The v1 bytes are retained unchanged for legacy records; v1 verdicts derived with the default-to-Kestra rule are explicitly requalified, not grandfathered.

removed_distortions: No default-to-Kestra: missing, absent, contradictory, or ambiguous carrier facts raise TOOL_SELECTION_UNRESOLVED naming the missing facts; no silent default row exists.

graph-property is not LangChain: LangChain is an optional integration library that may attach only to a T6 LangGraph carrier with an explicit langchain_integration fact; genuine cycles require genuine_cycles=true and multiple agents alone never qualify LangGraph.

owner_table.work_type: pure collection, counting, hashing, validation, routing

owner_table.note: missed_run_policy catch_up is durable recovery — file clock_critical (T3) instead

owner_table.work_type: resident service, socket, watcher, hardware connection

owner_table.note: no approved/auto-approve fact is accepted anywhere; consent is a Gate-D event, never a selection input

owner_table.work_type: dynamic multi-agent graph with real cycles/backtracking
owner_table.note: multiple agents alone do not qualify; cycles require the genuine_cycles fact
deterministic code, never selected here and never model-decided

owner_table.work_type: public posting, email, payments, destructive effects
owner_table.note: an outward_effect fact names the deterministic executor behind Gate-D; it selects no framework

contradictory_fact_pairs.detail: clock-critical workflow evidence conflicts with a resident held-resource claim

unresolved_semantics: If no carrier fact converts, the selection raises TOOL_SELECTION_UNRESOLVED naming every missing carrier fact. Ambiguous or contradictory facts raise a typed block. There is no default row, no environment override, and no caller override.
model_necessity: MODEL operation allowance is granted only by an evidenced agent_reasoning record plus the source-inventoried model_necessity_claims list. A framework token or name containing 'pydantic' never grants MODEL allowance.

property_definitions.claim_semantics: A property is claimed by supplying an evidence record over exactly its schema fields; CODE derives the boolean from the record. A well-formed record whose evidence fails its acceptance predicate is a CONTRADICTED claim and BLOCKS — it is never silently read as FALSE. An absent property is not claimed and is FALSE. No bare booleans are accepted anywhere.

clock_critical.meaning: Durable, clock-critical work: a named consumer waits on start latency and missed runs must catch up.

evidence_schema.consumer: non-empty string — the named consumer waiting on start time
evidence_schema.start_latency_ms: integer 1..60000 — the SLA; looser is an ordinary schedule (Kestra)
evidence_schema.deployment_evidence: non-empty path — evidence the mechanism is deployed

resident_service.meaning: A held resource: socket, watched directory, hardware connection, or sub-second OS event stream.

evidence_schema.resource_kind: one of listening_socket | watched_directory | hardware_connection | os_event_sub_second
evidence_schema.resource_detail: non-empty string — which resource and the reaction requirement

non_engineer_surface.meaning: Human-oriented judgment coordination maintained by a non-engineer; the human decision is necessary.

evidence_schema.expiry_date: 'YYYY-MM-DD' or null; an engineer maintainer requires an expiry date (bounded demo)

non_engineer_surface.note: No approval, auto-approve, or consent field is accepted; T5 can never self-approve.

multi_agent_graph.meaning: Genuine cycles/backtracking with dynamic branching — not merely multiple agents or a graph library import.

evidence_schema.graph_shape: one of cycle | dynamic_router | distributed_tracing | context_compression
evidence_schema.genuine_cycles: boolean — true is required to convert the claim; a claimed cycle with genuine_cycles=false is contradicted

agent_reasoning.meaning: A bounded model proposal demonstrably helps; the deterministic alternative was tried and rejected.
agent_reasoning.note: Converts the operation owner to MODEL only together with model_necessity_claims; never selects a carrier.

deterministic_step.meaning: Pure computation: fixed inputs, deterministic transforms, exact repeatable outputs; no scheduler, no model.

ordinary_schedule.meaning: Ordinary scheduled run-to-completion work with explicit overlap and missed-run policy.

evidence_schema.cadence: non-empty string — the schedule (cron expression, interval, or named cadence)
evidence_schema.missed_run_policy: non-empty string; 'catch_up' is contradicted — durable catch-up is clock-critical recovery (T3 Temporal)

outward_effect.meaning: The unit has outward or irreversible effects; delivery runs through the deterministic executor behind Gate-D.

evidence_schema.gate_d_class: non-empty string — the Gate-D class governing the effect

outward_effect.note: Selects no framework; the carrier is chosen by the other facts. Never accepts an approval field — consent is the Gate-D event itself.

langchain_integration.meaning: An optional LangChain integration library attached to the T6 LangGraph carrier.

evidence_schema.integration_point: non-empty string — where the library attaches in the graph

langchain_integration.note: Valid only when the selected carrier is langgraph; with any other carrier the claim is contradicted. LangChain is never itself a carrier.

kestra.role: T2 carrier — code-owned cadence, overlap/retry policy, execution records
kestra.model: typed boundary only in justified model-dependent steps

temporal.role: T3 carrier — durable history, replay, deadline/missed-run semantics, idempotent activities
temporal.model: activities only; never in workflow replay

launchd.role: T4 carrier — resident lifecycle ownership, single-instance, reconnect/state recovery

orca_pydantic.role: T5 carrier — real human decision handoff, durable pause/resume, typed proposals
orca_pydantic.model: proposes; the human decides; no fabricated consent

langgraph.role: T6 carrier — persisted checkpoints, bounded genuine cycles/backtracking, restart
langgraph.model: agents where useful, bounded in code

langchain.role: OPTIONAL integration library on the T6 LangGraph carrier only
langchain.model: n/a — never a carrier, never selected alone

legacy_token_semantics: Legacy tokens are compatibility metadata only. A token with no carrier facts raises TOOL_SELECTION_UNRESOLVED — the v1 default-to-Kestra row no longer exists.
certification_boundary: validate_lattice remains A1-only. Higher-mode certification requires a separately approved trusted-receipt implementation; a self-authored failure record cannot authorize escalation.
build_checklist: build declares process_id and the inventory_sha256 snapshot it was generated against; certification recomputes the live inventory and only binds when the declared process matches the target AND the declared hash equals the live hash (stale or mismatched checklists are CHECKLIST_BLOCK, never rebound)
framework matches select_framework() output for the declared properties; properties with no converting carrier fact block the checklist with TOOL_SELECTION_UNRESOLVED
flowise verdicts are prototypes; no durable system declares flowise
every MODEL op has typed pydantic input/output schemas
every MODEL op has a D85 necessity record
orchestration (schedule, retry, timeout, cancellation, dispatch) is deterministic code
lattice cell is canonical, A1, and its recomputed BMS mode matches the cell
archify diagram is present, inside the declared root, and hash-named in the check detail

changes: selection contract is now machine-readable at runtime: select_framework loads precedence and contradictory_fact_pairs from this file and carries no inline owner table; a missing or mismatched standard raises TOOL_STANDARD_UNAVAILABLE (fail-closed, no code fallback)
precedence carries the plan carrier order — graph (T6) outranks human-coordination (T5); a genuine graph with a non-engineer surface routes LangGraph, not Orca
removed the default-to-Kestra row: no carrier fact -> TOOL_SELECTION_UNRESOLVED naming the missing facts
removed graph-property -> LangChain: langchain is an optional integration library on the T6 carrier only, cycles require genuine_cycles=true, multi-agent count alone never qualifies LangGraph
MODEL allowance tied to the source-inventoried model_necessity_claims list, never to framework names containing 'pydantic'
added T1 carrier fact (deterministic_step -> plain_python), T2 facts (ordinary_schedule: cadence/overlap/missed-run), T8 effect fact (outward_effect -> gate-d-deterministic-executor)
default_used retired from the selection result together with the default row
v1 standard bytes retained unchanged for legacy records
